findings.rationale: Core: the instruction promises files of up to 500 records and the program accepts a file with no header, so 500 customer records is in contract. The only fixture at the limit spent one record on a header (499 C records), so a port that keeps one of its 500 places for a header passed. Added long_run_no_header: 500 C records, no header, and 500 postings with one to each account including the last, sizes asserted in the test.

gate.not_mechanizable: which record kinds count toward a stated capacity, and whether a structural record (header) may be absent, is format-specific; recorded in AGENTS.md section 2: a capacity bound gets a fixture that reaches it with payload records alone when the structural records are optional
